signature.one_line: Music-only save-bait: quoted viewer question, caps reply, dark note-screenshot list, framed monogram card.
unique_devices: Small regular-weight quoted viewer question dead-centre at 50 % H, screen-fixed while the footage slowly pushes in
Two-to-three-word UPPERCASE reassurance line hard-cut in under the question at ~27 % of runtime
Answer delivered as real dark-mode phone note screenshots with accent 'yes' / red 'no' highlighter headings, paged every ~30 frames as save-bait
Black end card with a thin white rectangular frame, monogram, spaced caps wordmark and a serif 'by founder' line
signature.why_it_works: The hook is the viewer's own worry in their words; the answer is too dense to read at speed, so people pause, rewatch and save.

hook.type: Direct address (viewer's question quoted on screen)
hook.first_frame: behind-the-scenes studio wide of one person seated on a stool, light stands in frame, small white quoted question centred at 50 % height

structure.what: quoted viewer question over a slow push-in on a studio wide
caps reassurance line added under the question; push-in continues
hard cut to dark-mode note screenshots, highlighted yes/no category headings, a page every ~30 frames
static framed monogram end card, no spoken CTA

background_text.how: one line, sentence case in curly quotes, regular neo-grotesque 43 px white, centred, ink centre y 50.2 %, ~68 % W; on from frame 0, screen-fixed, no motion
regular caps 46 px white, centred at 57.3 % H, ~28 % W, hard cut in, hard cut out with the shot

cards_lists.how: full-frame dark-mode capture, body text light grey at x 11-89 %, headings with accent or red highlight bands, red cross emoji on the 'no' heading; hard page jumps every ~30 frames

broll_inserts.how: one person on a stool against a grey backdrop, crew gear visible at the edges

layout.what: full-frame footage, then full-frame screen capture
layout.how: no split or PIP; measured letterbox share 0.54 comes from the black UI / end card

camera.how: linear scale from wide to medium (~110-115 %) across the whole first shot; text stays screen-fixed

transitions.when: shot change at ~46 %, page jumps inside the screen section

end_card.how: black, 2 px white frame x 15-85 % / y 21-79 %, line-art monogram 28-37 %, spaced bold caps wordmark at 41 %, light caps sub-line, short rule at 53.5 %, serif 'by' + spaced serif founder name at 70.4 %; static

other_text_spec.type: hook title tiers (no speech captions; these are the only typeset lines over footage)

spec.script: latin (on-screen text only; no speech, music only)

case.quote: sentence case inside curly double quotes
case.answer: UPPERCASE with a double exclamation mark

spec.punctuation: curly double quotes around the question, inch/foot marks kept if present; double exclamation on the answer
spec.emoji: none on the title; one red cross emoji inside the list screenshot

grouping.words_per_caption: question: one full sentence (~7 words) on one line; answer line 2-3 words
grouping.sync: not tied to speech (none); question on from frame 0, answer hard-cut in at ~27 % of runtime (frame ~65 at 30 fps)
grouping.break: both lines hard-cut out with the first shot cut (~46 % of runtime)

layout.note: text sits over the subject's torso/background in a wide shot; screen-fixed (does not scale with the slow push-in)

animation.answer_entry: hard cut in ~65 frames after the start (full ink on the first frame, no fade / scale)
animation.exit: both lines hard-cut out with the shot cut to the list screens (~111 frames in)
animation.idle: no motion; the text stays fixed while the footage slowly pushes in

other_text_spec.type: phone note-taking screenshots (screen capture, not typeset)
other_text_spec.when: ~46-88 % of runtime, a new page every ~30 frames (hard cuts)
other_text_spec.bg: pure black #000000 dark-mode note-taking UI with the yellow-orange UI icons kept top and bottom
other_text_spec.text: light-grey #CAD1D1 body text, left-aligned at x 11 %, right edge ~89 %, line pitch ~3.8 % of H (estimated); headings highlighted: teal text #71CAC3 on a dark-teal highlight band #0F2025-#396060 for 'yes' categories, red/pink italic text on a dark-red band for 'no' categories, a red cross emoji before the 'no' heading

other_text_spec.when: ~88-100 % of runtime (~24 frames, static, hard cut in)
other_text_spec.text: thin (~2 px) white rectangular frame x 14.7-85 %, y 20.6-79 % (estimated); line-art monogram at ~28-37 %; brand name in bold geometric caps, wide tracking (~0.3 em), ink 1.72 % H, 48.6 % W, centre y 41.1 %; sub-line in light caps, same tracking, just below (~44.5 %); short white rule at ~53.5 %; small serif 'by' at ~63.5 %; founder name in spaced high-contrast serif caps (closest Playfair Display), ink 1.95 % H, 49.3 % W, centre y 70.4 %

style.look_intent: low-contrast, muted, neutral-warm; dim warm studio with a grey backdrop, then pure-black dark-mode UI

sound.music: music-only (measured), ~74 BPM estimate; calm/aspirational trend bed, no voice
sfx: none; cuts do not land on beats (measured cut_hit_share 0.0)

sound.method: heuristic (onset-envelope beat periodicity + level in speech gaps); not a classifier

use_when: no voiceover; a music-only post answering one common audience question
the answer is a list the viewer would want to save (categories, do/don't, requirements)
the brand has behind-the-scenes footage but no presenter to camera
the goal is saves/shares rather than watch time
avoid_when: there is a speaking presenter or interview to caption
the list must be readable without pausing (accessibility)
explanations that need more than micro length
brand_prompt:
Use /video-pipeline with /video-captions on videos/<project>. Apply style blueprint B07 (video-reference-match/references/blueprints/B07.json) to this brand.

BRAND TOKENS (use the brand's colour for each role; keep the contrast relationship — text and accent must stay >= 4.5:1 / >= 3:1 against what sits behind them on the footage):
- {{TEXT}}      default #FFFFFF (title lines, end-card type and frame)
- {{ACCENT}}    default #71CAC3 (teal 'yes' heading)
- {{ACCENT_2}}  default unmeasured red/pink ('no' heading; use the brand's warning colour)
- {{SURFACE}}   default #000000 (dark-mode UI / end card)
- {{CARD_BG}}   default #0F2025 (dark-teal highlight band behind 'yes' headings)
- {{FONT_DISPLAY}} default Inter 400 (title lines); spaced bold geometric caps for the end-card wordmark
- {{FONT_BODY}}    default Inter 400
- {{HANDLE}}    default @handle
- {{LOGO}}      default the brand's logo file (transparent PNG/SVG)
Keep the highlight band dark and the heading text light (>= 4.5:1 inside the band).
Canvas 1080x1920, sizes are px at that canvas; frame counts at 30 fps.

CAPTIONS
1. No speech captions (music-only format). If the edit has speech, do not add a caption track unless asked.

OTHER TEXT
2. Hook question (frame 0 to the first cut, ~46 % of runtime): the audience's own question in curly double quotes, sentence case, one line, {{FONT_BODY}} at 43 px, {{TEXT}}, tracking 0, no stroke / shadow / box, centred, ink centre at 50 % H, ~68 % W. Screen-fixed while the footage slowly pushes in.
3. Answer line: UPPERCASE 2-3 word reassurance ending in '!!' (placeholder 'KEY WORD!!'), {{FONT_BODY}} 46 px, {{TEXT}}, centred at 57.3 % H. Hard cut in ~65 frames after the start; both lines hard-cut out with the shot cut.
4. Proof screens: real dark-mode phone note screenshots of the brand's list, {{SURFACE}} background, light-grey body text left-aligned at x 11 % (~3.8 % H line pitch); 'yes' headings in {{ACCENT}} on a {{CARD_BG}} highlight band, 'no' headings in {{ACCENT_2}} italic on a dark-red band with a cross emoji; a new page every ~30 frames by hard cut.
5. End card (~24 frames, hard cut in, static): {{SURFACE}}; thin 2 px {{TEXT}} frame (x 15-85 %, y 21-79 %); {{LOGO}} monogram at 28-37 %; brand name in bold geometric caps, ~0.3 em tracking (ink 1.72 % H, ~49 % W, centre 41 %); light spaced-caps sub-line below; short rule at ~53.5 %; small serif 'by' at ~63.5 %; founder / team name in spaced serif caps (Playfair Display, ink 1.95 % H, ~49 % W, centre 70.4 %).
6. Footage: one slow linear push-in (~110-115 %) across the first shot; hard cuts only; music-only bed, no SFX.

GRADE
Grade from the user's footage (video-style / grade.py); target look: low-contrast, muted, neutral-warm; dim warm studio, then pure-black UI.

VERIFY before rendering
a) Render the hook question and the answer line with neutral placeholders ('Headline here, is this a question?' and 'KEY WORD!!'), then measure:
   python3 video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test-render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.1,0.475,0.9,0.52 --ink "{{TEXT}}:70"
   python3 video-reference-match/scripts/caption_probe.py <test-render> --out <dir> --at <t> --box 0.3,0.55,0.7,0.6 --ink "{{TEXT}}:70"
b) python3 video-reference-match/scripts/fit_font.py --font "Inter 400" --word "<your question line>" --ink 1.95 -> ~39-43 px (keep 43 px if your line spans <= ~70 % W); answer: --word "<ANSWER>!!" --upper --ink 1.72 -> ~44-46 px. The returned width is what the probe should read. Measure over mid-grey or darker background. (fit_font.py needs a target: --ink and/or --width; it returns the px that reproduces that ink for YOUR word plus the width it will read at that px. Requires Pillow.)
c) Positions within ±1 % H: question centre 50.2 %, answer centre 57.3 %, end-card wordmark 41.1 %, founder line 70.4 %.
